prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Repair text-editing commands in a custom iPad annotation view. Read interface.md. input_files.interface.md: Platform: iPadOS. Long press opens a bespoke menu with Rename Account, Copy and hidden Delete All. Paste appears even with unsupported clipboard data; Cut irreversibly removes selection before copying succeeds. Selection is lost when the menu opens.
